text: here is yet another bug. have an outliner -> select faces of it -> detach -> on the detachment, select 2 edges -> create face between two edges -> detached outliner exists, has no geometry, it is now all owned again by the outliner that it detached from
resolution: Create Face and edge extrusion now carry the selected welded edges' explicit outliner-part owner instead of rescanning coincident seam triangles and guessing from the first match. The pre-operation face-to-part table is carried through regrouping, cross-part edge selections are rejected, and a postcondition verifies every old and appended face still resolves to its intended owner; failure restores the pre-op journal snapshot rather than committing corruption. Added a coincident detached-seam Zig regression. Native mesh-edit tests and the full ReleaseFast editor build pass.
